sources.title: ACE-Step 1.5 - GitHub
sources.snippet: 🎵 Want a faster & more stable experience? Try acemusic.ai — 100% free! [2026-04-02] 🎉 ACE-Step 1.5 XL (4B DiT) Released! — We introduce the XL series with a 4B-parameter DiT decoder for higher audio quality. Three variants available: xl-base, xl-sft, xl-turbo. Requires ≥12GB VRAM (with offload), ≥20GB recommended. All LM models fully compatible. See Model Zoo for details.

sources.title: cmp-nct/acestep-v15-xl-sft · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is the XL (4B) SFT variant of ACE-Step 1.5 — a supervised fine-tuned model with ~4B parameters. SFT provides higher audio quality with CFG (Classifier-Free Guidance) support for fine-grained prompt adherence control.
